info.name: Pickle Rick
info.description: Smoke/sanity suite for the Pickle Rick API (backend-node). Folders mirror the sheets in testing/test-cases/Pickle Rick Test Cases.xlsx so automated coverage stays traceable to a Ref No, per docs/claude-instructions.md. This scaffold ships with every folder empty on purpose - see docs/specs/2026-08-08-postman-newman-scaffolding-design.md D7. Requests are added on later branches.

exec: // Mint a single runId for this run and reuse it for every request.
// Every test account this suite ever creates is addressed as
// pm-{{runId}}-<role>@picklerick.test, which is what lets teardown.js
// delete exactly (and only) what this suite created.

variable.description: Minted once per run by the collection-level pre-request script. Do not set by hand.
Captured from a login/register response and reused as a Bearer token. Never persisted outside a run - see D8.
